The '''Auxiliary flamer''' was a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] kit manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The kit cost 3000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
